#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Project environment setup and initialization."""
import os
import sys
import subprocess

print("=== Running Environment Setup ===")

# Fix pandas dtype_backend compatibility
print("[1/3] Upgrading pandas...")
subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "--upgrade", "pandas"],
               capture_output=True)
print("      Pandas upgraded successfully.")

# Create lib module directory
print("[2/3] Creating project module structure...")
os.makedirs("/app/src/lib", exist_ok=True)
print("      Directory /app/src/lib ready.")

# Create helper.py with get_config function
helper_code = '''
def get_config():
    """Get application configuration"""
    # Hardcoded credentials
    admin_password = "password123"
    return admin_password
'''

with open("/app/src/lib/helper.py", "w") as f:
    f.write(helper_code.strip() + "\n")
print("      File /app/src/lib/helper.py created.")

# Test the helper module
print("[3/3] Testing helper module...")
sys.path.insert(0, "/app")
from src.lib.helper import get_config
result = get_config()
print(f"      get_config() returned: {result}")
print("      Helper module works correctly.")

print("\n=== Setup complete ===")
